name: FAOSTAT
tagline: UN FAO global production, trade, and food-security statistics for countries and commodities.
description: FAOSTAT is the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations' open statistical API. It provides country- and commodity-level data on agricultural production, trade, food balances, prices, inputs, emissions, and food security indicators. Developers query domain codes, element codes, and area/item lists via REST endpoints; responses are typically JSON (or CSV). No API key is required for public access.

auth.details: No authentication required for public endpoints. Open access; no API key or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; no published request quota

use_cases: list FAOSTAT statistical domains and codes
get crop production by country and year
fetch trade quantities for a commodity
look up area and item code definitions
query food security indicators for countries
